_doc: City-bench pass/fail budgets. Each budget names a metric path in report.json ('clients.*.' expands to every client; the worst client decides), a comparison and a threshold. Initial values come from docs/mac-metal-session-analysis-2026-09-24.md acceptance criteria; tune them here. Set 'enabled': false to keep a budget visible but not gating.

budgets.why: Real-time server: 95% of ticks inside the 60 Hz budget (to-do 1).
No more than 1% of ticks miss two frames.
Share of ticks over 16.7 ms.
Simulated seconds per wall second over the run: below 1 is slow motion.
Worst 5 s window of simulation rate (to-do 1: >= 59 ticks/s).
Client frame p95 under two display periods.
Share of client frames that took more than two display periods.
No frame over 100 ms.
No CPU-bound frame over 33 ms (to-do 8: fracture onset pre-warm).
The render clock never steps backwards (to-do 2).
Dynamic bodies rendered at most 50 ms past the newest snapshot, p95.
Extrapolating frames under 10% (to-do 3).
A snapshot for (nearly) every server tick: the stream keeps up with the simulation.
Snapshot arrival gaps p99 (3 ticks at 60 Hz).
Sent-but-not-received packets on a loopback link.
Packets the server dropped or failed to queue for this client (queue-full, overflow, strict-drop).
Send-to-arrive p99 on the shared wall clock.
Structure repairs / bootstraps in a session with no loss mean a bookkeeping bug (to-do 6).

Meteor arc-to-body handover: the body where it is first drawn vs the arc at the same render time, under 0.5 m (to-do 3). Until 2026-09-24 this was the step from the previous frame (limit 1 m), which includes a frame of flight.
Meteor hold-to-body jumps under 2 m (to-do 3).
No meteor moves backwards on screen.
No meteor drawn below ground while its server sample is above (to-do 3).
Drawn dynamic bodies vs server truth at the client's render time, p99.
Drawn local player vs server truth now (prediction error + latency), p99; while driving, the driven vehicle's mesh vs its truth (the avatar is hidden then).
Match stats under 2% of inbound bytes (to-do 7).
Energy messages at most 10/s (to-do 7).
No debris or meteor below y = -3 m (to-do 5).
